title: The Secret Warrior
paragraphs: So, I won the Colosseum tournament. That means I’ll be getting more Filolial now. Way to go!

As I was thinking that and picking up my prize money—a bag of gold—at the Colosseum reception desk, I noticed someone a little ways behind me, surrounded by pigs… What was his name again? It looked like that weakling from the first round, with his head hanging low.
“Damn… What’s with that guy! There’s gotta be some underhanded debuff affecting this Colosseum.”
“‘Oink oink! Oink oink!’”
“Otherwise, there’s no way I’d lose. Damn it, I have to win here to save that girl. I held back too much so I wouldn’t get caught!”
That’s just the howl of a defeated loser. Not my problem. I’m heading out of the arena to put some distance between myself and those pigs.
“Oink!”

Hm? I thought I saw one of those pigs point at me, but there’s no need to pay them any mind. Still, it’d be a hassle if they followed me. So, as I make my way through the crowd, I’ll use my Cloaking Lance to take off my mask. It’s gotten dirty from sweat, so I’ll have to give it a good wash.
The Filolial Mask is that of a secret warrior. My true identity must not be revealed.

That said… it’s still a bit early to head home. I’ll stop by the Zeltoble Guild. I need to check how much credibility I’ve earned within Zeltoble by winning this tournament and report back to Father. In Zeltoble, there are various factors that determine one’s standing, including trust, for both adventurers and merchants. With my track record by now, I’d think it’d be a breeze to get a Class Up.
With that in mind, I’ll take a look around the Zeltoble Guild. Hmm? There’s a notice posted on the bulletin board in Melromarc script that reads, “Urgent: Seeking Contact.”
Adventurer Myne, please contact us.
That’s what it says. HAHAHA! There’s no such thing as a Crimson Swine in this world! I don’t know who or where this person is, but they’ll be waiting forever for a reply!

With that thought in mind, I checked the trust I’d built up within the guild, then headed home that day. That night, a drunk woman—Older Sister—got all over Father, and for some reason, I ended up having to drink with her until I passed out. Even though I have alcohol resistance (Low, Medium, High, Extra High) from the Spear Unlock, I just couldn’t handle it.
“Ugh… I’ve had enough.”
I closed my eyes with a thud, but the world kept spinning in a rainbow of colors, and in that dazzling world, I watched as Filo-tan flew through the air.
“‘Motoyasu! Ahahahaha—’”
“There’s so much Filo-chan…”
“Oh? Motoyasu’s passed out… To shut him up, it’d be quickest to set Sadeena on him and have her finish him off.”

“You shouldn’t make Motoyasu-chan deal with my Older Sister too much, you know. Guh… No matter how strong I get, I’m no match for Older Sister or Father when it comes to drinking. Someday, I’d like to drink with Father and the others until the very end. And so, as I watched Filo-tan dance right before my eyes that day, my consciousness began to fade.
For the next two or three days, I was a walk-in contestant at the Colosseum of Darkness… I’d been invited as a measure against Colosseum vandals.
“Gah! The Filolial Mask! You again?!”
“That’s exactly what I was going to say.”

Apparently, someone named Seven… Ball or Dragon All—I can’t remember which—is trying to disrupt the Dark Colosseum using underhanded tactics in pursuit of a huge prize. So, I was called in as a bodyguard. If I win, I’ll get a special reward, and it’ll boost Father’s standing, so there’s no reason not to participate.

It seems this Seven Ball who showed up this time had made it all the way to the Dark Colosseum semifinals. He’s even brought his pig buddy along. It’s a two-on-two match, but I’m competing alone. I can handle these guys all by myself, after all.
“You’ve been showing up day after day! But it won’t be that easy this time!”
Unlike in the beginning, he’s lost his composure. In battle, it’s important to maintain both composure and passion at the same time, you know?
Oh? It looks like a Magic spell that lowers my stats has been cast on me. But something this minor is no problem at all.
“They keep coming at me from every direction. I’m getting pretty sick of your attacks, you know.”
“Oink oink oink!”
Looks like he’s teamed up with that creepy pig in a maid outfit. No matter how many of these guys you bring along, you won’t be able to beat me.
“Bub!”

The pig in the maid costume and Dragonall lunged at me as the bell signaling the start of the match rang. Their movements are a bit sharper than usual. They’re probably under the effect of Support magic.
“Another mindless charge, is it?”
“I don’t think so. Don’t count on that despicable debuff Magic you mess up every time working this time. This time, you’re the one who—”

He’s muttering something about a debuff Magic, but it’s actually me who’s under its effect. But that’s no reason to make a fuss. With practiced ease, I slip behind the maid-costumed pig and the Seven Dragons…
“It’s no use trying to sneak around behind us again!”
Looks like they’ve read my move, so I’ll change course mid-maneuver. I’ll circle around to the front and knock them out with a home run from my spear.
“Oink!?”
“Ughaaaaaa――”
And just as those fools are about to crash into the Wall, I’ll cast Magic on them without hesitation. Ah, I must make sure to cover my tracks so I’m not exposed as the Hero.
“Drifa Rapid Fire”
I’ll cast a spell that fires dozens of rather weak fireballs. It’s actually a low-power attack—not really my style, to be honest.
“Magic of that caliber? We’ll counter it immediately…”
“But it’s already too late.”
“What!? Before Magic even—”

The fireballs are so slow they make me yawn. I’ve even shortened the incantation as much as possible without giving myself away. I’ll outrun those sluggish projectiles and punish these idiots who keep causing trouble day after day without learning their lesson.
“Guaaaaaaaah!”
“Boooooo!”
After giving each of them a thudding jab to the shoulder about twice, I leaped aside. Just as they groaned, the Magic I’d unleashed came in for the follow-up strike.
“Wh—”
“Buhiiii!?”

My “Drifa Rapid Fire” hit the Dragon Pig Maid Team, setting them ablaze and causing an explosion, so I turned my back and struck a victory pose. I took the pose of the raging Lord Filolial, spear raised.
“Guaaaaaa!”
Huh… That was a perfect finish.
“‘Ooooooooooooooooooooh!’”
A wave of applause and cheers erupted in the Darkness Colosseum. At the same time, there was a thud as the Pig Maid Ball Team collapsed. They’re completely unconscious.
By the way, what was this guy’s player name again?　I can’t quite remember. Maybe I should finally learn it. I’ll make sure to remember it when I see him tomorrow.
“The winner is aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa! Filolial Maaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
“Ooooooh!”
“It’s Quay!”
In that instant, I became a hero. The crowd’s reaction made it clear just how much trouble those guys had been causing.

And just like that, I earned another bounty today, and Father’s standing has risen. By the way, as a mysterious merchant who’d shot to fame overnight in the past few weeks, Father had begun to command respect in Zeltoble.

It’s not just my record in the Colosseum—he’s been involved in a wide range of ventures, from using Filolial for transportation and managing food distribution through Bioplant, to partnering with a merchant famous for monster trading and accessory crafting, as well as providing medical care and welfare to mercenaries. And yet, he’s reportedly risen to prominence remarkably quickly. There are also signs that the salvage operation of a sunken ship, led by my Older Sister’s Older Sister, is set to be a huge success. It seems he’s almost within reach of securing a free pass to participate in the Class Up program for the Dragon Hourglass class.

To think he’s accomplished all this in less than a month since arriving in Zeltoble… Father is truly remarkable. With these thoughts in mind, I welcome Father back as he returns from a one-night trading expedition in the horse-drawn carriage pulled by Filo-tan.
“Filo-tan! Father!　Welcome back! Oh?"
On Filo-tan’s head, who’s just returned, I spot a familiar, adorable crest. Ooooooh… so this means… that, right?
“Oink… I don’t like it—I look like that guy with the spear.”
“I’ve told you time and again to just put up with it. Motoyasu probably modified that mask based on what you’ll look like in the future, so this was bound to happen.”
“Oink.”
“Oink.”
Don’t go grunting along with that Lazy Pig, Filo-chan. There’s a world of difference between you and Filo-chan, after all. You’d better keep that in mind.
“Sigh… The world is full of mysteries; it’s tough, isn’t it?”
“True. Oh, Motoyasu, is it?”
I stare intently at Filo-tan, but for some reason, she pulls her robe down over her face to hide it. It’s cute to see her acting shy, but I’d like to see more of her.
“I noticed something familiar on Filo-tan’s head a moment ago.”
“Ah… Yesterday, I was camping out between towns. I could’ve had Filo watch the cargo and gone home for a bit, but I figured it wouldn’t hurt to do this once in a while…”
As he said that, Father told me the story of how he’d encountered a giant Filolial. So it seems he really did run into a giant Filolial-sama.
“Oh, so you met a giant Filolial-sama! I would’ve loved to meet one too.”
“Aren’t you, a Filolial fanatic, the better person for the job?”
“That’s true. But giant Filolial-samas tend to vanish before you even realize it.”
“Knowing you, you’d probably cause some kind of trouble.”
“I seem to recall that during the last loop, you, Father, for some reason put me in a bear hug.”
“Is that so…? It’s a good thing you weren’t there.”
Huh? What does that mean? As I looked at him with a puzzled expression, Father ignored me and said,
“Well, either way, it’s for the best since it’s further boosted the limits of Filo’s abilities.”
“This time, I’ll definitely manage to outrun that guy with the spear!”
“Well then, Filo-tan! Is it date time again today!?　“Father! When will my tires be finished!?”
“Tires!?”

Filo-chan turned her face toward Father. That’s right. I’d been begging Father to develop tires for Drive Mode. Once the newly developed tires are finished, I’ll show him my Second Mode. I’m sure he’ll be delighted.
“That’s something you’re developing on your own, isn’t it?”
“Filo, you’ve got your work cut out for you.”
“Ugh… Filo wants to go out more.”
“Well, why don’t you come with me?”
“Boo! Don’t come near me!”
Oh, Filo-tan’s running even faster now. I’ll have to keep working harder and harder, too.
“It’s getting dark, you know? Cut the playing short… It’s about time to start preparing dinner.”
“I’ll help.”
“That’s a relief. The slaves who want to cook have already done the prep work. Let’s get cooking.”
That’s how our fun dinner time went.

I thought that would be the end of the day, but then, later that night… Just as I was about to head out to visit Lord Filolial and the others in the middle of the night, some people who looked like minions of the Monster Merchant showed up at the house where Father and the others live.
“What’s going on?”

Father answered the door. Well, it would probably backfire if I tried to get involved. I leave all business matters like this entirely up to Father, so it’s best for me to just sit back and relax. With that in mind, I waited until the conversation was over, and then Father began getting ready to go out.
“What’s going on?”
“Ah, there’s good news and bad news.”
Good news and bad news, you say? What could have happened at this late hour?
“The bad news is that there’s going to be a meeting right now at the Dark Merchants’ Guild in Zeltoble.”
“A meeting at this hour?”
Big Sister asks Father. Even in Zeltoble, the city that never sleeps, this certainly isn’t the time for a meeting. Well, maybe that’s exactly why it’s bad news.
“Ah, it’s an emergency. I don’t know what it’s about, though.”
“And what’s the good news?”
“At that meeting, I’ll likely be appointed to a certain position within the Dark Merchants’ Guild. This should free us up to use the Dragon Hourglass.”
Oh! The time has finally come for Father to be recognized! From now on, Lady Filolial and the others will be able to go hunting without worrying about level caps.
“Oh my—Naofumi-chan, what a huge promotion! Isn’t that happening at an incredible pace?”
“Well, yeah… Anyway, Sadeena. You seem to have a good eye for people, so come with me. Raphtalia, please stay with Elena and keep an eye on Motoyasu, Filo, and the villagers.”
“I’ve been given an incredibly difficult task!　Elena’s always sleeping, isn’t she? She definitely won’t do a thing!”
That’s right. A Lazy Pig is always just being lazy. In that regard, since I and Filo-chan are hard workers, please leave it to us.
“It’ll be fine. I’ll give instructions via the slave mark. I’ll make sure she’s not allowed to sleep until we get back, so just bear with it. If you’re a good girl, I’ll bring you back a souvenir.”
“I’m not a child!”
“All right, all right. Now, Motoyasu.”
For some reason, Father is pointing right at me.
“Behave yourself. Don’t chase after Filo or sneak into her room until I get back. Just stay put. Got it?”
“Yes, sir!”
Father’s orders are absolute, after all. I, Motoyasu, will make sure to follow them no matter what.
“…Do you really understand? Well, fine.”
And so, Father left with my Older Sister.
The Heroine of Seven All –1
